items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet. Fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown. No clean bill of health or vulnerability finding is supported. Recommend preserving private-launch and security-sensitive release gates while allowing only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.
